result.stdout:
Usage: credfeto-build-dotnet [--self-test | --help]

With no option, serves MCP over stdio for the repository in BUILD_MCP_REPO_ROOT (when unset, /workspace/repo if it exists, else the git root of the current directory; a value that is not an absolute path is an
error). The chosen repository root and where it came from are written to stderr at startup.

Options:
  --self-test  Builds the service provider and resolves every dependency, then exits: 0 when that works, 1 with
               a one-line reason on stderr when it does not. Starts no MCP transport, reads no input and opens
               no file or network connection; the repository is only located (git runs when BUILD_MCP_REPO_ROOT
               is unset and /workspace/repo is missing), never read.
  -h, --help   Shows this help and exits.
